packageRules.description: Automatically merge minor and patch-level updates

Group RustCrypto digest-ecosystem crates so they upgrade in lockstep. The `digest` trait crate is shared by sha*, hmac, rsa, signature, etc., and a major bump of one (e.g. sha1 0.10 -> 0.11 moves to digest 0.11) breaks compilation against any sibling still on the old `digest` major. Keeping them in one PR forces them to land together.

Hold sha1 < 0.11 until rsa 0.10 stable releases. sha1 0.11 moves to digest 0.11, but our transitive rsa 0.9 still requires digest 0.10, so Sha1 no longer satisfies rsa::Oaep::new's DynDigest bound. Tracked in shakenfist/ryll#93 / RustCrypto/RSA#647.
Hold rand < 0.9 until rsa 0.10 stable releases. rand 0.9 restructured CryptoRngCore, which rsa 0.9 calls through. Tracked in shakenfist/ryll#93 / RustCrypto/RSA#647.
Hold rand_core < 0.10 to stay aligned with the rand 0.8 / rsa 0.9 pin above. Tracked in shakenfist/ryll#93 / RustCrypto/RSA#647.

Hold webrtc < 0.18 until the 0.20 port lands. webrtc-rs 0.20 re-homes the crate on the sans-io `rtc` protocol core behind a thin async layer, which makes it a port of shakenfist-spice-webrtc/src/bridge.rs rather than a version bump: the `api`, `interceptor`, `track` and `rtp` top-level modules are gone, RTCPeerConnection's operations moved onto the object-safe `PeerConnection` trait, the per-object callbacks (on_peer_connection_state_change, on_data_channel, on_message) collapse into a single PeerConnectionEventHandler passed to PeerConnectionBuilder at build time, `gathering_complete_promise` and `connection_state` have no direct replacement, and the builder now requires explicit UDP bind addresses. Renovate raised this as shakenfist/ryll#245; CI failed with 25 errors in the lib and 36 in the lib tests. Estimated at roughly a week and tracked in docs/plans/PLAN-webrtc-0.20-upgrade.md; remove this rule when phase 2 of that plan lands.

Skip in-range (lockfile-only) patch bumps of webrtc. webrtc-rs releases its sibling crates (webrtc-util, webrtc-sctp, webrtc-ice, webrtc-srtp, webrtc-data, webrtc-media, webrtc-mdns) in lockstep but declares loose version ranges on them, so bumping only webrtc's lock entry can yield an inconsistent set — webrtc 0.17.2 sets the mtu field on webrtc_sctp Config, which only exists in webrtc-sctp 0.17.2, breaking the build against the still-locked 0.17.1 (shakenfist/ryll#215). The siblings are transitive deps that Renovate cannot bump via grouping, so in-range webrtc patches instead arrive through lock file maintenance, whose full `cargo update` advances the whole family together. Minor/major webrtc updates rewrite Cargo.toml and re-resolve properly, so they stay enabled.
